title: Stand inside the Stonehenge stone circle, free, for the winter solstice
alt: A single tall, rough standing stone in grassland, with the ring of stones and visitors far off on the horizon under a cloudy sky.

posts.facebook:
Picture yourself among the stones at Stonehenge, the ancient stone circle in the south of England, at the winter solstice.

That day, English Heritage, the charity that looks after Stonehenge, opens the stone circle to everyone, free. This year it's on Tuesday 22 December.

Travel by public transport through the nearby city of Salisbury if you can: anyone coming by car must pre-book parking or be turned away. Dress for a cold night outdoors, and check English Heritage's list of items that aren't allowed.

Would you go?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/visit-a-stone-circle-at-solstice/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
